items.source: Uses of NestedTestConfiguration.EnclosingConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context` 包中 `NestedTestConfiguration.EnclosingConfiguration` 的用法

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate how test configuration from enclosing classes is processed for inner test classes.
items.translation: 枚举模式，用于规定如何处理外层类中的测试配置以应用于内部测试类。

items.source: Get the EnclosingConfiguration enum constant with the supplied name, ignoring case.
items.translation: 获取具有指定名称（忽略大小写）的 `EnclosingConfiguration` 枚举常量。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
